title: Patriots to release Stefon Diggs, New England saves more than $16 million against cap by parting ways with WR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Stefon Diggs to be free agent after Patriots release
sources.description: Stefon Diggs has been informed he will be released by the New England Patriots after one season with the team. The wide receiver will be a free agent.
